seeded_on: CPython 3.12.13, the version the gate job pins
why_pip_audit_findings_is_9_2026_08_29: Nine advisories across five transitive deps at seeding: cryptography 49.0.0, requests 2.32.3, mcp 1.27.2, pyasn1 0.6.3, pydantic-settings 2.14.1. Severity-agnostic by design — OSV often reports none. Ratchets down as the lock is refreshed.
why_secret_findings_is_0_2026_08_29: First scan reported 1345 generic-api-key hits, every one a provider-key fixture stub re-counted across the commits that touched three files. Allowlisted by path in .gitleaks.toml; see the note there.

policy.comment: Higher-is-better metrics may not drop; lower-is-better may not rise; boolean_must_be_zero fails on any non-zero value regardless of baseline. Tolerance absorbs measurement noise, not regressions. See docs/quality-gate.md.

marim_harness.why_no_mypy_errors_2026_08_29: This repo type-checks with pyright, which ci.yml enforces at zero — stricter than any ratchet. The gate ships no pyright parser, and bolting mypy on purely to feed this row would mean a second type checker with its own config and a large starting error count. Revisit if a pyright parser lands upstream.
marim_harness.why_complexity_is_61_2026_08_29: The gate force-selects C901 plus PLR0911/0912/0913/0915. ruff.toml only selects C901 (max-complexity 10), so the other three rules were never enforced here: 48 PLR0913 (too many arguments) and 13 PLR0911 (too many returns), all in src. 30 further findings in tests/ are excluded by non_ratcheted_dirs and stay visible in the artifact.
